title: Data-model mismatch across schema, API, and view breaks CRUD end-to-end
description: Verified: three layers describe three different data models. api/debug/init.sql:3-9 creates items(item, description, created_at, updated_at). api/crud/get.ps1:20 and post.ps1:48 query a 'feature' table (application, featureName, featureText, tag, rank) and get.ps1:50 queries a 'tag' table that no SQL file creates. views/components/crudmgr.pode:106-107 renders {{item}}/{{description}}. Against a freshly initialized DB, every /api/crud request throws (no feature/tag tables) -> HTTP 500; the demo cannot function end-to-end.
notes: Resolved by deleting the demo feature/tag domain (per .aidd/responses.md approval), not patching it. Removed api/crud/{get,post,put,delete}.ps1 and views/components/crudmgr(-new).pode, and rewrote api/debug/init.sql + clear.sql to the single canonical pantry items model (name, category, quantity, unit, expiry, threshold, notes, timestamps). That schema now matches Initialize-PantryStore in api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1 (the DAL, single source of truth) and the pantry views (inventory/lowstock/expiring). A repo-wide grep confirms no orphaned feature/tag table references remain. Pester (tests/pantry.Tests.ps1) initializes the store and asserts Get-PantryItems returns rows in order; 50/50 tests pass, 0 PSScriptAnalyzer errors.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. Choose the single canonical entity for this project - per .aidd/spec.md this is the pantry 'items' model (name, category, quantity, unit, expiry, notes, threshold, timestamps).
2. Rewrite api/debug/init.sql to create exactly that table (and any lookup tables actually referenced).
3. Rewrite api/crud/get.ps1, post.ps1, put.ps1, delete.ps1 to query the same table/columns.
4. Update views/components/crudmgr.pode template tokens to match the API response fields.
5. Remove all orphaned 'feature'/'tag' references OR the orphaned 'items' schema so exactly one model remains.
6. Add a Pester test that initializes the DB, performs a GET, and asserts a 200 with rows.

approval.decision: Approved. Per .aidd/responses.md: the feature/tag demo domain is discarded � resolve this finding by deleting the demo code path as Pantry is modeled fresh, not by patching it.
